task: Limit Chaos Mesh to the chaos-testing namespace and run its controller manager non-root (CIS 5.1.x RBAC and 5.2/5.7 pod security)

events.summary: Owner decision D-OWN-CHAOS (chat, 2026-11-25): Chaos Mesh limited to namespace chaos-testing; controller non-root where the chart allows. Other components, acceptance rules and the chaos daemon are out of scope.

Portal 1.1.29 measured as its ServiceAccount on 2026-11-25 lists Chaos Mesh controller findings under CIS 5.1.3 (wildcards) and 5.2/5.7 (root controller); the RBAC triage (.omc/live/remediation/triage-rbac.md, P2) and pod triage (Batch 9) identify cluster-wide bindings and a root controller.
evidence: test:live read-only measurement via kubectl proxy as system:serviceaccount:devtools:narwhal-portal (2026-11-25) -> 21 actionable CIS controls; Chaos Mesh rows in .omc/live/remediation/triage-rbac.md and triage-pod.md

events.summary: chaos-mesh Application: clusterScoped false with controllerManager.targetNamespace chaos-testing (RoleBinding in that namespace instead of ClusterRoleBinding), enableFilterNamespace false because the namespace-scoped role cannot read Namespace objects, and controller pod securityContext runAsNonRoot with UID/GID 65532 and RuntimeDefault seccomp (D-OWN-CHAOS).
